question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined words in the given sentence.**

I was so nervous for the job interview that I was **__sweating bullets__** the whole time.
solution:
The correct answer is **"extremely nervous or anxious."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase** "sweating bullets"** is an idiom that means to be extremely nervous or anxious. (अत्यधिक घबराना या चिंतित होना)

 
 
• **Example**: *I was **sweating bullets**__ over this interview.*
 
 
 
• The speaker is expressing how nervous they were for the job interview.
 
• The correct answer is Option 2.
